comment: Boston is the absolute man and the best Spanish Teacher I ever had. He is incredible at explaining concepts in Spanish that don't translate very well to English. Very accessible outside of class

I took LAIS 221 last semester and Professor Woofolf was BY FAR the professor to have. Even though the class itself is tough, he makes it totally doable, he cares about his students so much and is always willing to help. Before taking the class Spanish was not my strong suit but he made me actually enjoy the class. Would 100% recommend, he rocks.
Do yourself a favor and take his class. Boston is the man

Taking woolfolk was the best decision I've ever made. He's such a good guy, cares about his students so much, and is such a good teacher. There is homework every night but its easy and he gives you sample tests so you aways know what's on it and the format. Show up and try hard and you can get an A even if you are bad at spanish

The hype is real. Dr. Woolfolk is one of the best professors I've had at UR. His high-energy, enthusiastic approach to Spanish made me excited to go to class each day, despite my relative lack of interest in the subject. He's super accessible and caring, and was extremely helpful in office hours. His grading is very fair with detailed feedback.

Nicest teacher at Richmond. Very caring for his students and helpful. Not that much work for a 2-credit course and you get a redo on every essay to bring your grade up. Would 100% take this class again to have him as my teacher.
He's such a great professor - thoughtful, clear expectations, understanding.
Boston is the man. Best professor you could take for Spanish 221 and probably my favorite professor on this campus.

Prof. Woolfolk was one of the best teachers I've had at any level. Incredibly funny, caring, and puts so much effort into making a tedious class enjoyable. I don't consider myself a strong Spanish student, but absolutely loved his class. Highly recommend this class for anyone who took Spanish in HS and needs to fill the language req.

Love this man. You can tell he puts effort into ensuring that his lectures are interesting and informative. Knows a lot about the language and will follow up on your questions the next day if he doesn't know the answer immediately. Really funny, intelligent, and caring guy - definitely the ideal professor if you're taking Spanish 5 days a week.
Boston Woolfolk is a shining light in this senseless dismal world we inhabit. 11/10

Dr. Woolfolk makes learning Spanish fun and enjoyable. Even though it is a class that meets everyday, he still made sure that it was engaging. He is always willing to meet outside of class, and he truly does want us to succeed. He's one of the best professors I have ever had here! 100% would take his class again.
Boston is one of the best professors I have had. He cares about his students and is a fair grader. Keep up with the homework and you should be good.

Dr. Woolfolk is a great professor who cares about his students. He is always willing to help outside of class, and he really goes above and beyond in trying to make the class enjoyable. He's one of my favorite professors here!

Professor Woolfolk is an incredible professor. He is extremely personable and makes it clear he just wants you to leave the class knowing some spanish. He is a relatively easy grader and is very accessible. He is funny and makes a 5 day-a-week class as enjoyable as it can be. HIGHLY RECOMMEND
